CHAPTER 7 · ITEM 08 / 10

Efficiency and welfare

Underproduction and overproduction過少與過多生產

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Identify lost gains from trade when quantity is below the efficient level, and the loss from units whose marginal cost exceeds marginal value when quantity is above it.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

產量不足會漏掉價值高於成本的交易；產量過多會完成成本高於價值的交易。兩者均減少相對有效率水平的總剩餘。

Below efficient quantity, some omitted units have value above cost, creating unrealized gains. Above it, extra units cost more than their value. Both reduce total surplus relative to efficient output.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：An unnecessary unit worth $4 costs $7, reducing surplus by $3. 過量的一件令總剩餘少三元。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

An extra unit has value $2 and cost $6. Its effect on total surplus? 額外單位的效果？
